item.subject: maths
item.stem:
Kabir looks at the diagram. Ray $OA$ and ray $OB$ meet at $O$ and form $\angle AOB$. A full turn around $O$ is split into $360$ equal parts.

Which claim correctly assigns a degree measure to $\angle AOB$?

options.A: The measure is the count of those equal one-degree parts that lie between ray $OA$ and ray $OB$.
options.B: The measure is the printed letter $O$ at the vertex, read as the degree number.
options.C: Any count of parts between the rays is a degree measure, even if the parts of the full turn are unequal.
options.D: Counting one-degree parts between the rays is what creates the full $360$-part turn.
